consumer_contexts: Standalone immersive painting: controller-authored free-space artwork with brush selection, local undo and document save.
Embedded spatial annotation: mark up a host-owned model or training scene with constrained brushes and host-owned target references; no standalone art application or scene ownership.
proposed_common_kernel: A retained document with explicit identities, ordered finite spatial samples, channel semantics and local coordinate metadata.
A limited brush-reference and parameter contract independent of shaders and art assets.
Whole-stroke create/remove/replace through the existing attributed intent requirement; local count-bounded undo/redo as a proposed module.
Versioned snapshot conversion and validation boundary; canonical operation replay and persistent history deferred.
configurable_variation: Sampling/filtering, pressure mapping and point budgets.
Allowed brush definitions, host target references and edit policy.
Input, rendering, storage/format and optional collaboration adapters.
excluded_project_specific: Product brush libraries, shaders, artwork, scenes, UI layouts, branding and platform accounts.
Multiplayer authority, transport, conflict resolution and shared anchors.
Content-pack installation and scene placement ownership.
blockers: Review the completed pinned Blender, Open Brush and Slicer evidence against each precise mandatory kernel clause in source-to-capability.md; distinguish recurring functions from stronger Foundry validation/ownership guarantees.

Resolve stable stroke identity, snapshot ownership, exact coordinate conversion and failure semantics in a narrow proposed contract. The audits identify concrete upstream differences, not an automatically inherited API.

Record the authoritative system-admission decision and public implementation task only after the existing criteria are satisfied; then create the admitted blueprint and staged implementation with named tests.
non_claims: This worksheet is intentionally not an instance of the authoritative system-admission schema, whose decision field requires admission. No admission record is added.
No package identity, implementation, compatibility, maturity, release, runtime, device, fidelity or performance claim.
Proposed consumers are proof obligations, not existing validated consumers.
